parsed.population_and_sample: Residents of two neighborhoods (Mutondo and Jardim Catarina) in São Gonçalo, Rio de Janeiro; 91 households surveyed (46 in Mutondo, 45 in Jardim Catarina).

parsed.outcome: Water security, frequency of access, service quality, and adaptation behaviors.
